name: Inverted Math in Discount Calculation
description: calculate_discounted_price subtracts price from discount instead of discount from price.

scripted_response.root_cause: Inverted subtraction order in calculate_discounted_price yielding negative prices.
scripted_response.proposed_change: Subtract discount from price instead of price from discount.
scripted_response.unified_diff:
--- a/src/pricing.py
+++ b/src/pricing.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def calculate_discounted_price(price: float, discount: float) -> float:
-    return discount - price
+    return max(0.0, price - discount)
